meta.parties: Perera v. Pelmadulla Rubber and Tea Co

rules.statement: A co-owner building on common property is entitled to compensation for improvements, but the amount cannot exceed the value of the improvements or the actual expenditure incurred, whichever is less.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right of the latter [a co-owner] is to either the value of the improvements, that is, to the difference between the original and the enhanced value of the property, or to the cost of the improvements, whichever is less."
